name: Dumbbell Swing
description: Holding one dumbbell by one end in both hands, hinge and let it swing back between your legs, then drive your hips forward to swing it up to chest height.

source.title: Spotebi: Dumbbell Swing
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold one dumbbell by one end in both hands, arms long.
Feet a little wider than your hips.

prescription.note: Explosive hips, controlled arms. Stop the set before your form fades.

keyframes.name: Hike back
keyframes.cue: Hinge and swing the bell back between your legs.

keyframes.name: Swing up
keyframes.cue: Snap your hips forward; the bell floats to chest height.
